paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (your documents and signatures), the signing certificate in cert/, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Documenso web app, API and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6142

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Documenso at, like http://192.168.1.20:6142. Replace [SERVER-IP] with your server IP, or use your own domain if you put Documenso behind HTTPS. Documenso only works at exactly this address. If it does not match what is in your browser's address bar, sign-up and sign-in fail with "Failed to fetch".

variables.name: DOCUMENSO_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you will sign up with. That account becomes an admin as soon as it is created. Leave it blank for no admin.
